# Erdos.p931 — Erdős problem 931

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/931
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/931.lean`, theorem `erdos_931.variants.exists_prime`, AMS 11).

Erdős was unable to prove that if the two products have the same factors
then there must exist a prime between $n_1$ and $n_2$.

## Statement
∀ (k₁ k₂ n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : k₂ ≤ k₁) (h₂ : 3 ≤ k₂)
    (h₃ : n₁ + k₁ ≤ n₂) (h₄ : (∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k₁, (n₁ + i)).primeFactors =
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k₂, (n₂ + j)).primeFactors), ∃ (p : ℕ), p.Prime ∧ n₁ ≤ p ∧ p ≤ n₂

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
